name: agent-read-flow
intent: Ensure an agent loads governance context before generating any UI.
sequence: Read the core docs in mandatory order (README through BRAND_THEMING)
For each component you intend to use, read its agentic-prompt.md, .agent.json, then .md
Only then generate UI composed of indexed components
requiredRules: Do not generate code until required documentation has been read
Verify every component exists in COMPONENTS_INDEX.json before use
forbiddenRules: Do not add npm packages or build tooling
